scope: Approved sections 1 and 2: verify the staged platform adapters and build the complete fresh decision-owner catalog/proposed mapping; stop for review before scenario/rule storage
implemented_local_not_pushed: Tenant- and transaction-bound MySQL record-tag, latest-risk and textual IP-flag repositories, with required local authorization callbacks, shared codecs/transaction cleanup and explicit row/aggregate-text budgets.

Additive three-table platform definitions and source-bound reference-plan builder using the shared owner migration runner. Reference observations in tests come only from generated disposable databases; no production definitions are learned/adopted and no frozen 8.4.8 release artifact is supplied.
Complete 17-business-column platform source mapping, non-unique generated SHA accelerators plus full binary residual equality, storage NUL checks and no silent truncation/partial successful lists.

Driver-neutral confirmed risk absence in both readers; arbitrary failures and a successful nil result without confirmed absence remain errors. Latest-risk equal-time ties use created_at DESC,id DESC in both readers.

Fresh PG16 decision schema catalog through migration 22: full column defaults/nullability/collations, constraints/reference bindings, expression/partial index definitions, complete routines and trigger definitions.

Proposed target mapping for every captured owner object, with scalar/JSON/ordered-array/null/default/reverse/preflight rules, source/query candidates and reviewed source-owner DML sets; unresolved target/security choices remain explicitly proposed/blocked.
Unit source/proposal drift test and required disposable-PG catalog comparison; unknown table/type/default/constraint/routine kinds are not silently accepted.
Updated module checklist and readable review checkpoint; no scenario/rule storage implementation, runtime switch, deployment or push in this pass.

catalog_coverage.note: Decision-only fresh migration catalog, not every core/shared database table or the deployed database. Query associations are source-fragment/manual-contract candidates, not a complete SQL parser/call graph or proof of index usage.
